# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Appearance

He wears a hat and works at a desk near the dais and blackboard in the schoolhouse.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P59](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0059)_

## Personality

He is prone to overbearing and sarcastic discipline, often using a mocking tone that stings his pupils' feelings. He lacks effectiveness in maintaining schoolroom order, ignoring younger children to focus his efforts on preparing older students for Regent's examinations. He displays sudden, fleeting impulses to enforce strict rules and acts with grave gravity when punishing students.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Overbearing  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)</sub>
- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>
- Ineffective  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching algebra and preparing students for Regent's examinations  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

As the schoolmaster of Brierley School, Mr. Pidgeon tutored older pupils in preparation for Regent's examinations, including instructing students in subjects like geometry and algebra. During a school day, he miswrote Nell Harcourt's name without the final 'e' on the blackboard, prompting Hugh Carrow to tease her and leading to a classroom disturbance where Nell smashed her slate over Hugh's head; Mr. Pidgeon punished Nell by forcing her to stand on the dais while writing a public admonition about her temper on the board. On a subsequent day, after attempting to enforce strict arrival times following dinner, he singled out Nell when she ran into the schoolhouse alongside the tardy boys and forced her to sit next to Hugh Carrow as a sarcastic penalty. His harsh treatment and mockery caused Nell to refuse to return to school, prompting her to study at home instead.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P82](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0082), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Background by volume

- Secured and maintained his teaching post at Brierley because his uncle controlled the school board of trustees  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Lodged at the residence of Eben Duckett during his teaching term  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>

## Quotes

> Nell Harcourt, what is the meaning of this?  <sub>[v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>

> Nell Harcourt, because you appear to take such pleasure in the presence of the boys, we will satisfy your desire for it later today. Remove those blossoms from your hair and take a seat next to Hugh Carrow.  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>

> Nell, did you hear my words?  <sub>[v1 c15 P63](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0063)</sub>
